route_note: Take a minibus or bus from the Amman Abdali or Wihdat bus stations toward Jerash (about 1 hour), then a short taxi to the ruins if you don't want to walk.
Take a minibus or service taxi from Amman's Abdali bus station to Madaba (about 45 minutes to an hour), with taxis available for the trip on to Mount Nebo.
see: Madaba Mosaic Map in St George's Church
tour_query: Madaba and Mount Nebo day trip from Amman

route_note: Take a minibus or taxi from Amman to the Dead Sea shore at Sweimeh (about 1 hour), and reach the beach resorts by local taxi or shuttle.
tour_query: Dead Sea day trip from Amman
